Steps.Message:
Sent by Roland at 02:21 - Our engineers have completed their investigations and have identified that access issues mean there is a lot of work required to safely repair the fault.

To restore power as quickly as possible, we'll be sending temporary generators to the area first thing in the morning, along with a morning relief team to support our engineers and progress the repairs.



To allow time for the generators to arrive and be connected, we're now estimating that power will be restored between 10:30 and 11:30. 

We're sorry for changing the timeframe and appreciate your patience while we work to get your power back on. 

We won't send any further text updates overnight, but we'll provide you with another update in the morning.
